newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Denko requoted at 18 rgt after stake buy.
newsitem.headline: Denko requoted at 18 rgt after stake buy.

text.p: Shares of Denko Industrial Corp Bhd were requoted after a 13-day suspension on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Thursday at 18.00 ringgit.
Denko shares were suspended from January 31 for an announcement of the company's acquisition of a 45 percent stake in a Mongolian oil reserve.
Denko has said it is acquiring a stake in Australia's NTI Resources Ltd which owns part of the reserve, for 42 million ringgit.
Denko has said that NTI Resources owns a 42.6 percent stake in SOCO Tamsag Mongolia Inc, the concession holder for 10.7 million acres of oil reserves in Mongolia's Tamsag basin.
The reserves are estimated to hold about two billion barrels of recoverable oil and are expected to be commercial in three years.
At 0200 GMT Denko was trading 50 cents lower than its January 31 closing price of 17.70, at 17.20 ringgit.
